questions.question_en: Did Moses' mother hide him in a basket by the river?
questions.question_ko: 모세의 어머니는 아기를 바구니에 담아 강가에 두었나요?

questions.question_en: Did Miriam watch over baby Moses from far away?
Did the princess throw the basket away when she found it?
questions.feedback_en: No, she loved him and named him Moses!
questions.feedback_ko: 아니에요, 그녀는 그를 사랑하고 모세라고 이름 지었어요!
